verdict.rationale: Airweave is a data-sync and search platform. It could plausibly consume external MCP servers, for example as sources or as tools for its agentic search, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Airweave acting as an MCP server for other assistants (docs-5, docs-30), which is the opposite role and earns no credit here. Nothing shows that users can register or connect external MCP servers for Airweave to call their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
